prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1050; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a sideswipe collision during a lane change. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the right side. Both drivers stopped at the scene. Police report requested. Claimant reports neck pain and a headache following the impact and states they were diagnosed with a concussion at the emergency department. Claimant is not represented by an attorney.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant describes dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating at work. Claimant has not yet returned to full duties. Explained the claims process and the bodily injury coverage available under the at-fault driver's policy. Requested medical records and the emergency department discharge summary. Claimant agreed to sign authorization forms.

Entry 3: Reviewed the scene photos and vehicle damage estimate. Damage is consistent with a glancing side impact to the rear quarter panel of the claimant's vehicle and the front fender of the insured's vehicle. Witness statement obtained confirming the insured signaled but the other vehicle was in the blind spot. Liability appears probable against the insured, pending review of the police report.

Entry 4: Received treating physician's note confirming a concussion diagnosis and recommending a period of cognitive rest followed by gradual return to activity. Claimant has scheduled a follow-up with a neurologist. Advised claimant in writing that they may wish to consult an attorney, and that the adjuster cannot provide legal advice. Claimant acknowledged receipt of this notice.

Entry 5: Reviewed medical documentation and vehicle repair invoice. Injury evaluation is ongoing because the claimant's recovery timeline is not yet established. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the injury claim. Supervisor notified. Next step is to request an updated medical status report in thirty days and continue monitoring for any change in the claimant's condition.
